review_limit: The assistant assessed the literature and inspected the task-only changes. No independent literature, novelty, manuscript or new scientific result review occurred. Existing R35/R36 approvals do not cover this publication judgment or these new documents.

commands.scope: Regenerated the update index without changing the original frozen catalog.
Frozen bytes, source coverage, identifier presence and link portability; not semantic completeness or scientific acceptance.

commands.command: git diff --check -- info/NOTES_AND_INSIGHTS.md info/TODO.md info/README.md info/SOURCE_COVERAGE.md

additional_read_only_checks.scope: The script resolved every figure JSON pointer, checked scalar/interval type and finiteness, checked patient and row counts for all displayed cohort arms, checked touched-page links with the existing documentation checker, and compared existing dirty bytes against the preserved starting snapshot. It computed no new scientific metric or interval.

not_performed: Training, model fitting, prediction replay, MRI access, data acquisition or private participant export
New bootstrap, significance test, scientific measurement or published-method reproduction
Plot or HTML generation, rendering, or pixel review; the deliverable is a figure design only
Independent novelty or manuscript review, workshop selection, submission or acceptance
Python compilation, because this task changed no Python file
Commit, branch switch, shared-output modification or R37 execution-window renewal
